title: Getting started, connecting and Find your people guides match the product

source.ref: Help center audit and rework 2026-11-18 (project thread: Rework every help doc and help search)

detail:
Owner ask 2026-11-18: read every help doc against the code and fix what is stale. The audit found, among others: how-to-rsvp.md gave the answers as Going and Interested (they are Going, Maybe, Can't go, components/events/rsvp-controls.tsx) and guests as plus one or two (up to five); your-settings.md described one scrolling page with sections that no longer exist (Settings is a side list of panes, settings-body.tsx); four articles sent people to Settings, Connections & Location, which is gone (Privacy, Location, Feed); messages.md said only Crew and Hosts can start an open room (any member can); your-feed.md and your-first-week.md described the retired home design; marketplace.md said /marketplace opens on Classifieds (it opens on Market); the Find your people articles named event filters that do not exist and stated outcome claims as promises.

DONE 2026-11-18: all 32 articles in the three folders rewritten against the code, with one format, search keywords and softened health claims. Market filters and message the seller are behind COMMERCE_CART_ENABLED, so marketplace.md describes them as rolling out.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
